name: goal
description: Goal: a branch keeps working toward a goal it was given

texts.objective: This is the user's standing goal for branch {branch}. If you are on another line of this Session, the goal belongs to branch {branch}: treat it as background, do not continue it, and do not call goal_update for it.
texts.continuation: Continue working toward the active goal for branch {branch}. If it is completed or blocked, call goal_update. If you are on another line of this Session, the goal belongs to branch {branch}: do not call goal_update for it.
